description: Source code for compliance-related functionalities in the Mattermost server, including retrieving, saving, and fetching compliance reports and files.

methods.name: GetComplianceReports
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of compliance reports if compliance is enabled and licensed.

methods.name: SaveComplianceReport
methods.description: Saves a compliance report, initiates a compliance job asynchronously, and returns the saved report.

methods.name: GetComplianceReport
methods.description: Fetches a specific compliance report by its ID.

methods.name: GetComplianceFile
methods.description: Reads and returns the compliance report file as a byte array.
